articles.title: Spy x Family Season 4 & New Film Confirmed For 2027 Release
articles.summary: 2027 will be a major year for Spy x Family as the anime is set to return with both its fourth season and a new movie to mark the fifth anniversary of the television adaptation. Both projects were revealed by TOHO animation during the “SPY×FAMILY ANIME EXTRA MISSION II” fan event held at Belle Salle ... Read more

articles.title: 'Spy x Family' Gets Season 4, Second Anime Movie in 2027
articles.summary: The Spy x Family Anime Extra Mission II special event announced a fourth season and a second theatrical movie on Sunday, revealing the production staff and a teaser visual (pictured) for Season 4. The new season and movie are scheduled for a 2027 premiere. Staff Director: Yasuhiro Akamatsu (Spy x Family Season 3 episode director) NEW Assistant Director: Hiroki Shinagawa (Lazarus sub character design) NEW Series Composition: Aya Takaha (Mahoutsukai no Yome script) NEW Assistant Series Composition
